messages:
Paritosh R: swing shift here — quick async rollforward + handoff. tl;dr: regen queue spike earlier (partial cause: burst of long-sequence requests), primary mitigation applied (throttles + restarted regen-worker), kvcache still showing intermittent evictions. leaving next steps below.
Anna L: thanks — status now? dashboards look green from my side but I still see sporadic 503s in eu-west.
Paritosh R: eu-west had a short window 21:32–21:50 where p50 p95 spiked. I applied a soft throttle on long-seq routes and restarted the regen workers: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/regen-worker -n prod`.
Paritosh R: logs I pulled around the spike:
```
2026-03-17T21:34:12Z regen-worker[12]: request_id=abc123 len=4096 model=redwood-2-xl latency_ms=1200
2026-03-17T21:34:13Z kvcache: evict key=chat-prefix:usr:42 ratio=0.82
2026-03-17T21:34:14Z regen-worker[12]: OOM avoided via splice; retried short-batch
```
Samir: noted. I left a temporary route policy that downgrades long-seq requests to the smaller model if queue depth > 80. It's documented in the runbook under "regen fallbacks".
Jen K: pinging @eng-runtime — should we keep the soft throttle for next 2 hours or revert earlier if metrics stay stable? :thinking_face:
Paritosh R: keep for 90m, then evaluate. If p95 < 400ms and kv eviction rate < 0.02/min for 30m, we can remove throttle. I put a dashboard watch on it.
Anna L: FYI I opened a bug for the kvcache eviction cascade: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-927 (small reproducer attached). Might need a minor tuning of the eviction policy.
Samir: I can queue a patch today — will target a small config change (lru_pressure_threshold) and a canary deploy to staging. PR: #3421 (WIP).
Paritosh R: good. Operational next steps for the oncoming shift:
- monitor regen queue depth and p95 latency (dashboard: Tools > Oncall > Regen Queue)
- watch kvcache eviction rate and storage OOM counters
- approve or comment on PR #3421 (Samir) if unit tests look good
- if spike recurs, escalate to eng-runtime and consider increasing dedicated pools for regen for 1 hour
Jen K: question on PR timing — if Samir posts the canary before my shift ends, I'll help validate metrics in staging.
Samir: plan is to open canary PR by EOD and request review from @Jen K and @Paritosh R. Will include logs comparison and a small perf test.
oncall-bot: incident RED-2026-03-17-regen-spike created — severity: SEV3 — link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/RED-2026-03-17-regen-spike
Paritosh R: leaving a couple of non-blocking items for the next oncall:
- follow up on RED-927 (kvcache reproducer)
- confirm rollback window for any model routing changes (I set automatic rollback at 22:50 UTC)
- escalate to infra if we see disk pressure on storage nodes (alert: storage.node.disk_usage > 85%)
Jen K: acked. I'll do a quick pass on the PR comments if Samir posts. good handoff :thumbsup:
Anna L: leaving the bridge notes in the handoff doc (Drive/Oncall/Shifts/2026-03-17.md) with links to dashboards.
Paritosh R: thanks all — off to grab dinner, ping me if it flares back up and I'll join. handing over to Jen for the next 4h window.
